sorry_inventory.why_deferred: NIK.diaWitness_transport (built in an earlier dispatch, a new diaE-shaped corollary of Phase 3's NIK.swap_relabel) only transports to TARGET labels fresh w.r.t. H.G.X; it cannot supply the fact for 'old' y' since its own hypothesis requires y'∉G.X, and H.G.X may be infinite so this cannot be guaranteed merely by choosing y' outside a finite L. This is the SAME root obstacle as Phase 3's deriv_reflect sorry above, confirmed independently. The fresh-label half of this argument, and all surrounding Context/maximality machinery, IS proven sorry-free.
